name: Cloud project
description: Project hosted by a cloud provider.

name.label: Name
name.description: Human-readable name of the cloud project.
name.help: Use the name by which the project is commonly identified.

extref_project_id.label: External project ID
extref_project_id.description: Project identifier assigned by the cloud provider.
extref_project_id.help: Enter the provider's project identifier, such as an OVHcloud or Google Cloud project ID.

cloud_provider_code.label: Cloud provider code
cloud_provider_code.description: Technical code of the cloud provider hosting the project.
cloud_provider_code.help: This value is derived from the selected cloud provider.

servers_ids.label: Servers
servers_ids.description: Servers hosted in the cloud project.
servers_ids.help: Lists the servers associated with this cloud project.

provider_catalog.label: Provider catalog
provider_catalog.description: Provider-specific resources available to this cloud project.
provider_catalog.help: Synchronize the catalog to refresh regional flavors, images, SSH keys and networks.

form.default.name: Cloud project
form.default.description: Displays and edits a cloud project.

action.create-ovh-server.label: Create OVHcloud server
action.create-ovh-server.description: Creates a server in this OVHcloud project.

action.sync-provider-catalog.label: Synchronize provider catalog
action.sync-provider-catalog.description: Refreshes the regional resources available to this cloud project.

errors.unknown_cloud_project: The cloud project was not found.
errors.unsupported_catalog_provider: Catalog synchronization is not supported for this cloud provider.
errors.missing_extref_project_id: The cloud project has no external provider identifier.
errors.missing_api_credentials: The cloud project has no API credentials.
errors.invalid_api_credentials: The cloud project's API credentials are invalid.
errors.failed_retrieving_ovh_time: The OVHcloud API time could not be retrieved.
errors.invalid_ovh_time_response: OVHcloud returned an invalid API time response.
errors.failed_retrieving_ovh_catalog: The OVHcloud resource catalog could not be retrieved.
errors.invalid_ovh_catalog_response: OVHcloud returned an invalid resource catalog response.
errors.missing_provider_catalog_regions: No configured region is available to synchronize for this cloud project.
errors.invalid_provider_catalog: The provider catalog could not be encoded.
